<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Trang-1" id="olhgPOGbmI-Pbyn-4pAi"> <mxGraphModel dx="934" dy="631" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Class Diagram (Domain Model) - Hệ Thống BrewLite

skinparam style strictuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam ClassBackgroundColor #F8FAFC
skinparam ClassBorderColor #0F172A
skinparam EnumBackgroundColor #FEF3C7
skinparam EnumBorderColor #B45309
skinparam ArrowColor #334155

' ==================== ENUMS ====================

enum OrderStatus {
 PENDING
 PAID
 PREPARING
 READY
 COMPLETED
 PAYMENT_FAILED
 CANCELLED
}

enum DrinkSize {
 S
 M
 L
}

enum PaymentMethod {
 E_WALLET
 BANK_CARD
}

enum PaymentStatus {
 INITIATED
 SUCCESS
 FAILED
}

enum LoyaltyTransactionType {
 EARN
 REDEEM
}

' ==================== CLASSES ====================

class User {
 + id : UUID
 + email : String
 + passwordHash : String
 + fullName : String
 + loyaltyPoints : Int
 + createdAt : DateTime
}

class Product {
 + id : UUID
 + name : String
 + description : String
 + basePrice : Decimal
 + imageUrl : String
 + stock : Int
 + version : Int
 + isAvailable : Boolean
}

class Order {
 + id : UUID
 + orderCode : String
 + userId : UUID
 + promotionId : UUID
 + status : OrderStatus
 + subTotal : Decimal
 + discountAmount : Decimal
 + total : Decimal
 + createdAt : DateTime
 + updatedAt : DateTime
}

class OrderItem {
 + id : UUID
 + orderId : UUID
 + productId : UUID
 + size : DrinkSize
 + toppings : String[]
 + unitPrice : Decimal
 + qty : Int
 + lineTotal : Decimal
}

class Payment {
 + id : UUID
 + orderId : UUID
 + idempotencyKey : String
 + amount : Decimal
 + method : PaymentMethod
 + status : PaymentStatus
 + providerTxId : String
 + createdAt : DateTime
}

class Promotion {
 + id : UUID
 + code : String
 + discountType : String
 + discountValue : Decimal
 + minOrderValue : Decimal
 + validFrom : DateTime
 + validTo : DateTime
 + usageLimit : Int
 + usedCount : Int
 + isActive : Boolean
}

class LoyaltyTransaction {
 + id : UUID
 + userId : UUID
 + orderId : UUID
 + type : LoyaltyTransactionType
 + points : Int
 + description : String
 + createdAt : DateTime
}

' ==================== RELATIONSHIPS ====================

User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Order : places >
Order \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" OrderItem : contains >
Product \"1\" <-- \"0..*\" OrderItem : references <
Order \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Payment : paid via >
Promotion \"0..1\" <-- \"0..*\" Order : applied to <
User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : earns/redeems >
Order \"1\" --> \"0..1\" LoyaltyTransaction : generates >

Order ..> OrderStatus
OrderItem ..> DrinkSize
Payment ..> PaymentMethod
Payment ..> PaymentStatus
LoyaltyTransaction ..> LoyaltyTransactionType

@enduml",
 "config": null
